text: Network Outage Detection, Triage and Communication Document ID: SOP_C08_OUTAGE_MANAGEMENT Category: C08 — Network Coverage & Outages Department: Network Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Purpose To define how network outages are detected, classified by severity, and communicated to affected customers. Scope Applies to all channels and customer segments unless a specific exception is noted below. Preconditions Customer identity verified (registered number and OTP where applicable). Account is active and not under a fraud, legal, or compliance hold. Roles & Responsibilities Required Information Registered mobile number / account ID. Nature of the request and any reference numbers already issued. Relevant transaction or ticket ID, where applicable. Procedure NOC detects fault via automated alarms or customer-reported tickets crossing threshold. Assign severity per the table above and open an incident record. Dispatch field team / activate failover (e.g., COW, backup backhaul) as applicable. Publish status to the customer-facing Service Status page within 30 minutes of P1/P2 classification. Close the incident once service is confirmed restored for 30 continuous minutes; trigger RCA process for all P1 incidents. Decision Points If the request falls outside standard criteria, route for manual review before proceeding. If suspected fraud indicators are present at any step, halt standard processing and route per the Fraud & Security Response SOP. Exception Handling Cases outside standard scope require supervisor sign-off before proceeding. Validation Confirm the account/system reflects the expected end state before the case is closed, and obtain customer confirmation where applicable. Escalation Escalations beyond
